This unsanctioned activity has resulted in unauthorized financial transactions at banki
items.summary: CERT-In warned that threat actors are carrying out AI-assisted cyberattacks targeting ICT assets in India. The title reports unauthorized payments at banks and fintech firms.
items.why: Review payment controls and investigate suspicious activity affecting ICT assets.

That was more than 4% of all connected TV (CTV) traffic HUMAN observed and more than three times the volume of VASTF

items.why: Check connected TV devices for compromise and unexpected use of home internet.

He explains what happens when a nurse can’t open a chemotherapy plan, how INT works with smaller partner hosp
items.summary: An interview discusses how a cancer hospital keeps research IT running while protecting it from cyberattacks, including challenges when staff cannot access systems.

items.title: Xalgorix: Open-source AI penetration testing tool
items.snippet: Xalgorix, an open-source AI penetration testing tool, checks its work before it reports anything. When its main agent finds a bug, a second agent has to exploit that bug again. If the second agent can’t prove the bug is real or rule it out, Xalgorix keeps the finding and flags it for a person to review. The check targe
items.summary: The Xalgorix open-source AI penetration testing tool uses a second agent to try to verify bugs found by its main agent.
items.why: Understand how independent verification can help assess reported security findings.

The company describes the lure most shoppers are likely to meet this season as “a post in a Facebook group or a page
items.summary: Doppel says fake Black Friday deals appeared earlier this year and often lacked the holiday wording or lookalike addresses shoppers might expect.
items.why: Train staff and shoppers to assess deals without relying on familiar scam red flags.

items.summary: The article argues that AI poses a major challenge to American civil-military relations and operates outside the political bounds that contain other challenges.

items.title: ASELSAN’s GÖKDENIZ Destroys High-Speed Jet Drone in Live-Fire Sea Trial

items.summary: Naval News reports that ASELSAN’s GÖKDENIZ system used automated target prioritization and single-button firing to down a jet UAV in live-fire sea trials.
items.why: The trial highlights automated target handling in naval defense against jet UAVs.

items.summary: The post says Ukraine destroyed a Russian corvette and struck two cargo ships, one in the Mediterranean and one in the Baltic.

Review payment controls and investigate suspicious transactions or activity in affected ICT assets.

learn.explainer: Remote code execution (RCE) is a vulnerability that can let an attacker run code on a device or system from another location. The Cisco Expressway item describes a critical RCE flaw.
Automated target prioritization is a system’s use of automation to rank or select targets for attention. The GÖKDENIZ report says the naval defense system features this capability.
Geopolitical times refers here to the international political conditions Australia’s prime minister cited when explaining why the UN climate talks ended without a deal.

analysis.headline: Systems, weapons and diplomacy under strain
paragraphs: Across today’s stories, high-consequence systems are central: AI in civil-military relations, automated naval defense, cyberattacks on ICT assets, and strikes affecting civilians. These reports differ in evidence and context, but together suggest that analysts must distinguish claims, confirmed details and unresolved questions.

For defenders, CISA’s warning about active exploitation of a patched Cisco Expressway flaw calls for attention to patch status. The CERT-In warning and BADBOX report add other areas to review: payment activity and connected devices. These cyber stories do not establish a shared campaign, so treat them as separate signals.

The reports of Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian ships near Libya include claims from Ukraine and a statement about the vessel’s stop from Libya’s eastern government. Meanwhile, the climate talks ended without agreement amid cited geopolitical divisions. Watch for further reporting that clarifies events, claims and operational implications.
takeaways: Verify Cisco Expressway patch status and review payment activity.
Separate reported claims from independently established details.
Track how AI and automation shape military decision-making and defense.
